# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/belebele
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/belebele

## File: facebookresearch_belebele/2M-belebele/dl_2mbelebele.py

Prompts

```
['download a single language parquet file from 2M-belebele speech dataset to an output directory', 'download multiple language parquet files from 2M-belebele speech dataset using the CLI with an output directory', 'download all 74 language parquet files from the 2M-belebele speech dataset to a specified directory', 'list all 74 available language codes for the 2M-belebele speech dataset parquet files', 'run the dl_2mbelebele CLI tool to download speech parquet files for specified languages to an output directory']
```

Usage

```
{'download_speech_parquet_single_lang': 'download a single language parquet file from 2M-belebele speech dataset to an output directory', 'download_speech_parquet_multi_lang': 'download multiple language parquet files from 2M-belebele speech dataset using the CLI with an output directory', 'download_all_speech_parquet': 'download all 74 language parquet files from the 2M-belebele speech dataset to a specified directory', 'list_available_speech_langs': 'list all 74 available language codes for the 2M-belebele speech dataset parquet files', 'run_dl_2mbelebele_cli': 'run the dl_2mbelebele CLI tool to download speech parquet files for specified languages to an output directory'}
```
